author: Brenner23
quote:
Absolute crap. I mean when I think GTA, I think crimes, violence (against EVERYONE), and fun. 

GTA 6 is none of those things. Can’t steal cars in your own neighborhood, can’t pick up ho*kers, can’t do dr*gs, can’t shoot up everyone.. just unprotected groups… whatever that means. 

If you want to virtually paint walls, grocery shop, and buy flowers for the most mid girl in the game… this is for you. Not GTA… sims… this game is sims…

I’d give it a negative rating if I could, especially after 13 years and $85 invested.
